description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and factory functions related to creating and managing test channel plugins for a plugin-based architecture. It defines types for test registrations, functions for creating plugin registry objects, and factory functions for creating mock plugins with specific capabilities and configurations commonly used in testing scenarios.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a mock plugin registry object with optional channel registrations, useful for testing plugin behaviors.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Generates a basic mock channel plugin object with specified parameters, used as a building block for more specific plugin instances.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a mock Microsoft Teams channel plugin with default configurations, extended to include descriptive metadata for testing.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a Microsoft Teams plugin instance with optional aliases and outbound adapter, built upon the base plugin.

methods.name: createOutboundTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock channel plugin with outbound adapter and optional messaging adapter for testing.

methods.name: createBindingResolverTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a mock channel plugin with optional resolveBindingAccountId setup, used for testing binding resolution.
